drinks.name: House Margarita
ingredients: 11.5 oz Rocks Margarita (pour 11.5 oz from prepared Margarita batch)
OR 9 oz Frozen Margarita (pour 9 oz from prepared Frozen Margarita batch)
drinks.glass: Frozen: Rocks Glass; Rocks: Tall Colins
method: Salt rim
Pour the margarita in the glass
Fill the rocks glass two-thirds full
Finish off by garnishing with a lime wedge

drinks.name: Heirloom Margarita
garnish: 1 lime wheel & spritz of Grand Marnier
method: Measure all ingredients into a shaker tin
Add ice to the shaker
Shake vigorously until well chilled
Double strain into a chilled coupe glass
Garnish accordingly with a lime wedge & spritz of Grand Marnier
Serve immediately

drinks.name: Texas Two-Step
ingredients: 2 oz Reposado Tequila or Mezcal (Guest Choice)
drinks.rim: Salt for Tequila | Tajín for Mezcal (setup also lists 'Mezcal: Tahini rim')
method: Measure all ingredients into a shaker tin
Add ice to the shaker
Shake thoroughly until well chilled
Strain over fresh ice into a Star Rocks glass
Garnish according to the recipe
Serve immediately

drinks.name: Paloma Reserva
method: Combine all ingredients, except the Grapefruit Soda, in a shaker tin
Add ice and shake thoroughly until well chilled
Strain over fresh ice into the appropriate glass
Top with Grapefruit Soda
Garnish according to the recipe
Serve immediately

drinks.name: Mezcal Negroni
drinks.tools: Jigger, shaker, Hawthorne strainer & fine-mesh strainer
method: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass filled with ice
Stir 20 times until well chilled
Double strain into a Star Rocks glass
Garnish according to the recipe
Serve immediately

drinks.name: Chilean Pisco Sour
method: Measure all ingredients into a shaker tin
Add ice to the shaker
Shake well until thoroughly chilled
Double strain into a chilled coupe glass
Garnish according to the recipe
Serve immediately
drinks.notes: No egg white on the printed recipe

drinks.name: Local'Lite
method: Combine all ingredients, except the Soda Water, in a shaker tin
Add ice and shake thoroughly until well chilled
Strain over fresh ice into the appropriate glass
Top with Soda Water
Garnish according to the recipe
Serve immediately

drinks.name: Piña Colada
ingredients: 8 oz Frozen Pina (pour 8 oz from prepared Frozen Pina batch)
method: Fill glass to a peak, garnish with (2) Pineapple Fronds/Pineapple wedge, and serve
Serve with straw

drinks.name: Martini Café Tamarindo
method: Add Free Spirits Bourbon Alternative, cold brew, Tamarind-Piloncillo Cinnamon Syrup, lime juice, and egg white to a shaker
Shake vigorously with ice for 10-15 seconds
Strain into small tin and remove ice and shake again until well aerated
Double strain into a chilled coupe
Garnish with a very light dusting of cinnamon or 3 coffee beans

drinks.name: Guava + Chile
method: Rim glass with Tajín
Add Ritual Agave Spirit Alternative, guava nectar, pineapple juice, lime juice, and Chile-Lime Syrup to a shaker
Add ice and shake briefly
Strain over fresh cubed ice into a Collins or highball glass
Top with 1.5-2 oz sparkling mineral water
Gently lift or stir once to integrate
Garnish with a lime wheel

drinks.name: Flight
ingredients: .75 oz of each tequila or mezcal for designated flight

drinks.name: Wine Pour
ingredients: Pour Guide: Use the stars marked on the side of the wine glass as your visual guide
Utilize the center mark of the star to achieve flawless 5 oz pours
Bottle Dating: Always date any newly opened bottle of wine
Quality Standard: Do not serve wine that has been open for more than 3 days

batches.name: House Margarita Batch
ingredients: 5 Qts Rancho Alegre Reposado (other sheet: 5 Qts 100% Blue Agave Tequila or Rancho Alegre Reposado)
2.5 Qts Rancho Alegre Reposado (other sheet: 100% Blue Agave Tequila or Rancho Alegre Reposado)
batches.tools: Combine all ingredients in a 22-quart Cambro, Stir, Label, date, and refrigerate, Note: Always stir before use

batches.name: Piña Colada Batch
ingredients: 9 Cans of Coco Lopez (shake until liquified)
3 Cans of Dole Pineapple Juice (46 oz cans)
batches.tools: Combine all ingredients in a 22-quart Cambro, Whisk & Measuring Cup, Label, date, and refrigerate, Note: Always stir before use
method: Combine all ingredients in Cambro
Whisk thoroughly until completely combined
Label - Product/Date/Initials
Store in Bar Walk-In or add into machine
During service, fill glass to a peak, garnish with Pineapple Fronds/Pineapple wedge, and serve

batches.name: Sangria Noir Batch
method: Combine all ingredients in Cambro
Whisk thoroughly until completely combined
Label - Product/Date/Initials
Store in Bar Walk-In or add into machine
During service, fill glass to a peak, garnish & serve

batches.name: Tamarind-Piloncillo Cinnamon Syrup
batches.tools: Sauce Pan, Hot Plate, Whisk, Strainer
method: Combine water, piloncillo, cinnamon sticks, and salt in a saucepan
Heat gently until the piloncillo is fully dissolved
Add tamarind and whisk until incorporated
Simmer gently for 5 minutes
Remove from heat and steep for 15-20 minutes
Fine strain
Cool completely
Bottle, label, date, and refrigerate

batches.name: Brandied Cherries
batches.tools: Cambro, Induction cook top, Bar spoon
method: Combine all ingredients except cherries. Heat at low temp. below 180 degrees until sugar dissolves
Add cherries, stir 7 times and remove from heat
Transfer to a 120quart Cambro (as printed)
Label, date, and store in refrigerated cooler
batches.notes: After using up all the cherries, the leftover liquid can be reused 3-4 times. Avoid filling the jar with more cherries than the liquid can cover. When the cherries begin to soften or show signs of fermentation, it's a sign to prepare a fresh batch.
